tier1.text: Together, the splenius muscles extend, or bend back, the head and neck. The splenius muscles can also turn the head and tilt it to the side. The splenius muscles, the splenius capitis and splenius cervicis, lie at the back of the neck. Each splenius muscle starts at the midline and runs upward and outward.

sentences.text: Together, the splenius muscles extend, or bend back, the head and neck.

quotes.quote: Either of the two superficial, posterior vertebral muscles located in the neck and upper thorax: the splenius capitis (cranial portion) or splenius cervicis (cervical portion). Together these muscles extend the head and neck.
quotes.citation: NCI Thesaurus (NCIt), National Cancer Institute, https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov

quotes.quote: extension: movement in the sagittal plane that increases the angle of a joint (straightens the joint); motion involving posterior bending of the vertebral column or returning to the upright position from a flexed position
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The splenius muscles can also turn the head and tilt it to the side.

quotes.quote: From the sides and the back of the neck, the splenius capitis inserts onto the head region, and the splenius cervicis extends onto the cervical region. These muscles can extend the head, laterally flex it, and rotate it
